## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Registered Institutions

## Licensing Information Booklet and Handling of Licensing Related Enquiries

This circular is to inform intermediaries that the Securities and Futures Commission ('SFC') has published a Licensing Information Booklet (the 'Booklet') providing useful information concerning licensing and related requirements under the Securities and Futures Ordinance. This circular also draws the attention of intermediaries on the SFC's policy in dealing with licensing related enquiries.

## Licensing Information Booklet

In  a  succinct  summary  format,  the  Booklet  covers  a  number  of  topics  such  as  types  of regulated activities,  scope  of  the  licensing  net  including  related  exemptions,  procedures  of applying for a licence or registration, basic approval criteria, on-going obligations of licensed persons and registered institutions, etc.  Further, in the appendix section of the Booklet, there is, among others, an elaboration of the licensing requirements for persons providing financial information on the Internet or on-line trading services.

The Booklet can be downloaded free of charge from the SFC website at http://www.hksfc.org.hk (under 'Intermediaries, Licensing &amp;  Investment  Products'  'Licensing Related Matters' - 'Licensing Related Publications' ).  Printed copies will soon be available for sale at $50 each at the SFC office.

The SFC would like to remind that apart from the Booklet, intermediaries may also access related information through the SFC Infoline (telephone number: 2840-9393).  A reference guide  to  the  Infoline  is  appended  to  the  Booklet  to  assist  users  in  obtaining  the  required licensing information or documents, e.g. licence application forms and notification forms.

## Handling of licensing related enquiries

It is believed that the Booklet, together with the  Infoline  and  other  supplementary information such as Answers to the Frequently Asked Questions posted on the SFC website, could  deal  with  most  enquiries  on  licensing  matters 1 .  Intermediaries,  in  particular  their personnel performing the compliance functions, should hence make good use of the materials available since they are primarily responsible for responding to their staff members' enquiries on licensing and related matters.

Where the matters warrant special consideration by us, the enquiries from licensed persons may be  raised  with  the  SFC through  the  compliance  personnel of  the  relevant  licensed corporations. In that regard, the compliance  personnel  should  contact the relevant Intermediaries Relationship Manager of the SFC Licensing Department directly.  Enquiries on  licensing  matters  other  than  those  raised  through  the  compliance  personnel  should  be directed to the Infoline 2 .  Enquiries from registered institutions and their relevant individuals should,  on  the  other  hand,  be  directed through  their  compliance  personnel to  the responsible case officer in the Banking Supervision Department of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority ('HKMA').  The above arrangement is implemented with a view to sustaining an equitable and effective deployment of regulatory resources.  Please bring this matter to the attention of your staff members and update your related internal procedures.

Should you have any queries on the above, please contact your Intermediaries Relationship Manager of the SFC Licensing Department.  If you are a registered institution, you may first contact your case officer at the HKMA Banking Supervision Department.

## Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission

1 To  obtain  information  on  the  administration  of  competence  examinations  for  the  purpose  of  licensing, intermediaries  should  directly  approach  the  relevant  examination  bodies,  e.g.  the  Hong  Kong  Securities Institute.  Related enquiries should also be raised with the examination bodies concerned.

2 If a caller of the Infoline cannot obtain the required licensing information, he may leave a message of his enquiries by pressing 2 - 3 - 9 after reaching the main menu of the Infoline.  We will endeavour to respond to those enquiries as soon as practicable.
